summaryBullets: Release: llm-gemini 0.38.1 Gemini 4 Carbon only supports low, medium and high reasoning levels - but Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Gemini 4 Neon both have an extra xhigh level.
I missed that when I added those models to the llm-gemini plugin, which is now fixed in this dot release.
The xhigh setting for Hydrogen makes a significant difference.
